scope: Forces on actual saved-version copper per phase ampere at zero winding excitation, at one saved pose in the existing static 36x12mm material-footprint prototype. Not mover thrust/Kf, finite-current backreaction, differential inductance, AC or hardware validation.

geometry_export.procedure: Archive original project, remove only backplane from a derived copy for the free-space copper exporter, verify resistance/current/signed trace-via samples, restore that one field and require exact equality to original. Original file untouched.
geometry_export.prior_version_not_reused: The previously audited v0 has a 1.6mm rather than 0.8mm PCB and different trace-width settings.

coupling.qualification_boundary: Lorentz force on copper is not automatically the negative of mover force when a magnetic stator can carry incremental force. Do not wire these coefficients into driver Kf. Material plate remains the explicit prototype footprint, not extracted full motor CAD.
coupling.superseded_audit: The v1 coupling report remains archived. V2 corrects comparison pairing so near-mesh NGSolve refinement uses the NGSolve baseline and 2%, not the different-backend 5% gate.

remaining: DC winding-current nonlinear bias and differential linkage/inductance
